result.topic_en: A single introductory sentence stating that the function of the apparatus in the tympanic cavity (middle ear) is to transmit air pressure to the fluid of the labyrinth; the rest of the page is blank.
result.transcription:
Man hat längst[?] erkannt, daß es die Aufgabe des Apparats in der Paukenhöhle ist, den Druck der Luft
auf das Wasser des Labyrinths zu übertragen.

items.quote:

items.english: It has long been recognized that the task of the apparatus in the tympanic cavity is to transmit the pressure of the air to the water of the labyrinth.
